description: Fill a prompt template with supplied variables. Use {name} placeholders with matching vars.name; missing variables become empty text. Returns a prompt string without invoking a model; code/image modes can add framing.

seed.description: Optional deterministic seed for the {{RAND_INT:min,max}} helper, not ordinary placeholders.

template.description: Template text, e.g. Hello {name}; omitted variables are replaced with empty text.

type.description: Prompt template category: text, code or image; default text.

vars.description: Object mapping placeholder names to values, e.g. {"name":"Ada"} for {name}.

name: generate-prompt
title: Fill a prompt template with variables
